sets.relationshipLabel: tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A chisel exists to carve and a plane exists to smooth — each tool is defined by the single action it performs.

sets.relationshipLabel: category and a kind of furniture within it
sets.explanation: A recliner is a kind of seating and a chest is a kind of storage — each pair names a broad furniture category and one member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: furniture piece and what it is built to keep
sets.explanation: A hutch is built to hold dishes and an armoire is built to hold linens — each piece is designed around what it stores.

sets.relationshipLabel: same kind of furniture, smaller then larger
sets.explanation: A loveseat scales up to a sofa and a nightstand scales up to a dresser — each pair is the same furniture type at two sizes.
